subject: Re: Demo request - Redwood Inference for MediCore
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@medicore.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 20:42:00 -0500
Subject: Demo request - Redwood Inference for MediCore

Hi Camila,

I signed up for Redwood and ran a couple quick tests with the hosted API. We're evaluating inference platforms to serve clinical NLP models (PHI-protected) for note summarization and coding. A bit of background: our expected starting volume is ~20k inference calls/day, with peaks up to ~10 concurrent long-running streams. We need HIPAA-compliant deployment (private/VPC or on-prem), audit logs, and KMS/HSM integration.

Pilot timeline: aiming to kickoff a Q2 pilot (April).

Can we schedule a 30-min demo this week or next to walk through platform capabilities, deployment options, and security posture? I'd like to include our engineering manager and procurement on the call.

I attached a short vendor compliance checklist for context.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Head of Data Platforms
MediCore Health
Attachment: healthcare-compliance-questions.xlsx

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@medicore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>; Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 21:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo request - Redwood Inference for MediCore

Hi Sophie,

Thanks for signing up and for the context - happy to help. Quick set of qualification questions so we make the demo useful for your team: 

- Primary use case: note summarization + coding (confirm)?
- Model details: are you evaluating a specific model family (e.g., Llama-3, Falcon) or bringing your own fine-tuned checkpoints?
- Average tokens/request and max sequence length we should budget for?
- Expected concurrency and peak TPS beyond the 10 concurrent streams mentioned?
- Any hard compliance requirements (SOC 2 + HIPAA is noted; do you need an on-prem option or is VPC sufficient?)
- Stakeholders: who from engineering + procurement will join?
- Timeline: is April firm for pilot kickoff or flexible?

If that looks right, here are a few 30-min slots I have next week: 2026-03-03 10:00am ET, 2026-03-03 2:00pm ET, 2026-03-04 11:00am ET. You can pick a time directly here: https://cal.com/camila-reyes/30min

I'll include Marissa (SDR) and Alex (Solutions AE) on the demo so we cover procurement and architecture.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.inference

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@medicore.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@medicore.com
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 09:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo request - Redwood Inference for MediCore

Hi Camila,

Thanks - answers below:

- Primary use case: yes, clinical note summarization + structured coding for billing.
- Model: planning to pilot with an LLM fine-tuned by our team (based on Llama-3 family) and also evaluate Redwood's curated models.
- Tokens: average ~600 tokens/request (long discharge summaries), peak up to 2,500 tokens in some cases.
- Concurrency: typical concurrency ~5-10 active streams; bursts up to 25 concurrent during daily batch windows.
- Compliance: VPC deployment with customer-managed KMS is preferred; we need audit logs and retention controls. SOC 2 + HIPAA requirements are firm.
- Stakeholders: myself (Head of Data Platforms), Mark Chen (Engineering Manager), and procurement (procurement@medicore.com).
- Timeline: April pilot kickoff is our target; earliest POC in late March would be ideal.

Let me know which of your suggested slots works.

Best,
Sophie
